services_heading: Complete Landscape & Driveway Services Across Leicester
services_subhead: From garden design and patio installation to driveway resurfacing and maintenance, we handle every aspect of outdoor transformation.

services.title: Garden Design & Build
services.desc: Bespoke garden layouts tailored to your taste and budget. We handle everything from initial concept sketches through to final planting and hard landscaping.

services.title: Driveway Installation & Resurfacing
services.desc: New drives, tarmac repairs, block paving, and gravel — all built to last. We prepare the base properly so your drive stays intact for years.

services.title: Patio & Decking
services.desc: Beautiful outdoor living spaces for entertaining and relaxation. We use premium materials and level everything perfectly for safety and appearance.

services.title: Fencing & Boundaries
services.desc: Strong, attractive fences and hedging that define your property and provide privacy. We repair damaged panels and install new boundaries to your spec.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular upkeep keeps your garden thriving. Grass cutting, hedge trimming, seasonal planting, and deep cleaning keep everything looking pristine.

services.title: Drainage & Groundworks
services.desc: Expert solutions for waterlogging, poor drainage, and site preparation. We ensure water runs away cleanly and your garden sits on a solid foundation.

about_pullquote: We build gardens people actually want to spend time in.
about_para_1: GB Landscaping & Driveways has been transforming outdoor spaces across Leicester for over 15 years. We started because we saw too many half-finished gardens and rushed jobs. From day one, we've focused on doing the groundwork right — no shortcuts, no cutting corners. Today, we've completed over 500 gardens and driveways, and we're prouder than ever of every single one.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us year after year because we listen, we deliver on time, and we stand behind our work. We don't just turn up and dig; we plan properly, explain what we're doing, and make sure you understand every stage. Whether it's a sprawling garden overhaul or a straightforward driveway repair, we bring the same care and attention to detail.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About GB Landscaping

reviews.text: Had our driveway completely resurfaced and it looks brilliant. The lads turned up on time, worked hard, cleaned up after themselves, and the finish is spot on. Would definitely recommend and will use them again for the garden next spring.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: They designed and built a patio at the back that's transformed how we use the garden. Really helpful when we weren't sure about colours and materials. Fair price and the whole job was done in two weeks. Top quality, no mess left behind.
reviews.author: Christine M.

reviews.text: Called them to sort out a waterlogged corner of the garden and they've not only fixed the drainage but also suggested a small raised bed area that looks lovely. Professional outfit, honest about what needed doing, and didn't overcharge. Will be calling them back.
reviews.author: David P.
